displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EEd
meaning: Auxiliary limit switch in the blower compartment is open. The furnace fails to operate.
causes: Circulator blower speed or a failed blower motor
Loose wiring in the auxiliary limit circuit
diySteps: With power off, check the filter and replace it if it is blocked. Open registers that are shut
Technician: check circulator blower speed and performance, and the auxiliary limit wiring
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if EEd returns after the filter and registers are clear. This is the blower-compartment auxiliary limit, not the primary limit code EE3.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
